subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice cadence, PO process & early-pay option
messages:
From: Elise Hunt <elise@orchard-sys.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@orchard-sys.com
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — invoices & payment cadence

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We (Orchard Systems) are getting our onboarding materials together and want to validate Redwood's expected invoice cadence and PO flow so we can finish the onboarding form. Two quick asks: 

1) What is Redwood's standard net term for new suppliers (Net 30 / Net 45 / Net 60)?
2) Do you offer an early-pay program (e.g., discount for payment within 10 days)? If so, what are the discount levels and how does enrollment work?

A little context: our accounting team typically invoices Net 30, but we can opt into a dynamic early-pay option (we'd like to know the mechanics). Also please confirm where to upload our W-9 and bank details and if a PO is required before invoicing.

I've attached our Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (filled) — please confirm the PO/invoice expectations so we can finish the form.

Thanks,
Elise Hunt
Head of Finance Ops
Orchard Systems
[Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Elise Hunt <elise@orchard-sys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — invoices & payment cadence

Elise — thanks for the form and the clear questions.

Short answer up front: Redwood's default is Net 45 for new vendors, but we commonly support Net 30 and Net 60 on a per-account basis. We do offer an early-pay program (vendor-funded discount) that you can opt into; details below.

On Tue, Mar 9, 2027 at 9:12 AM Elise Hunt <elise@orchard-sys.com> wrote:
> Hi Jordan,
> 
> Thanks for the quick intro last week. We (Orchard Systems) are getting our onboarding materials together and want to validate Redwood's expected invoice cadence and PO flow so we can finish the onboarding form. Two quick asks: 
> 
> 1) What is Redwood's standard net term for new suppliers (Net 30 / Net 45 / Net 60)?
> 2) Do you offer an early-pay program (e.g., discount for payment within 10 days)? If so, what are the discount levels and how does enrollment work?
> 
> A little context: our accounting team typically invoices Net 30, but we can opt into a dynamic early-pay option (we'd like to know the mechanics). Also please confirm where to upload our W-9 and bank details and if a PO is required before invoicing.
> 
> I've attached our Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (filled) — please confirm the PO/invoice expectations so we can finish the form.
> 
> Thanks,
> Elise

What I'll do: loop in Procurement (Marissa) and Finance (David) to confirm the exact steps and pilot options. High level notes / next steps from my side: 

- Standard term: Net 45 for most new vendors while credit/account verification completes.
- Alternate terms: Net 30 or Net 60 can be set if your AR team prefers — we treat these as account-level settings.
- Early-pay: Redwood has an opt-in early-pay program. Typical structure: vendor provides a small invoice-level discount (example: 1%–2%) for payment within 7–10 days. Finance executes payments through the AP early-pay portal; enrollment requires a signed addendum and bank details.
- PO requirement: Yes — a Redwood PO is required for services/products that were procured through our platform. For recurring subscription relationships we may issue a standing PO.
- Uploads: please upload W-9 and bank info to the vendor portal link below (secure). Do not email bank details.

I've uploaded a short Redwood_Vendor_Requirements.docx that lists the invoice header fields we need and the portal steps. I'll let Marissa confirm the PO timing and David confirm the early-pay discount tiers and DocuSign cadence.

Portal & DocuSign: https://redwood.example.com/vendor-portal/onboard/orchard | https://docusign.example.com/XXXXXXXX-XXXXXXXX-XXXXXXXX

Best,
Jordan Blake
Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Requirements.docx (DOCX)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elise Hunt <elise@orchard-sys.com>, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — invoices & payment cadence

Hi Elise — looping in procurement details so you have a clear checklist.

Key PO & invoice rules (please follow these to avoid payment delays):

- PO issuance: Once the account is activated (onboarding complete + W-9 & bank info verified) Procurement will issue a PO. For one-off quotes we issue PO within 3 business days of final SOW acceptance.
- Invoice header: Must include Redwood PO number, invoice date, invoice number, line item descriptions, and the Redwood project code (if provided).
- Invoice submission: Send invoices to ap-invoices@redwood.com with the PO number in the subject line: "PO 12345 — Invoice 0001". Do not CC individual approvers — that creates routing issues.
- Net terms & pilot: Default term for onboarding is Net 45. We can run a 90-day pilot where Orchard invoices Net 30 and Redwood enrolls Orchard in the early-pay program for the first three cycles. Pilot parameters:
  * Pilot term: 90 days (3 invoice cycles)
  * Payment timing during pilot: Redwood will attempt to pay on Net 30, but payments processed via AP early-pay portal may happen within 10 business days if Orchard opts-in to discounting.
  * Discount: Example pilot discount is 1.5% for payment within 10 calendar days; final discount to be negotiated with Finance (David).
- Required docs before PO: Completed onboarding form (attached), W-9, and bank details uploaded to the portal.

Attachment: PO_Acceptance_Checklist.xlsx — completes the onboarding steps and shows procurement SLA.

If Orchard is happy with the pilot, we can confirm discount band and DocuSign the addendum. Jordan — can you confirm the expected SOW acceptance date so procurement can schedule PO issuance?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO_Acceptance_Checklist.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Elise Hunt <elise@orchard-sys.com>

We're happy to run the 90-day pilot (Net 30 invoices + early-pay opt-in). A few quick items from our side: 

- We'll upload the W-9 and bank details to the vendor portal today and re-submit the onboarding form with the additional fields you flagged.
- Contract SOW is being finalized — legal expects signature by Monday 15 Mar. If that's accurate, when can we expect the PO to be issued? Our AR team needs the PO number to start dispatching invoices on Net 30.
- Regarding discount: 1.5% for payment within 10 days sounds workable. Please confirm with David and include the final discount in the DocuSign addendum so our team can opt-in electronically.

Appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Elise Hunt
Head of Finance Ops
Orchard Systems
